```{python}
#| label: fig-custom-flow
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Mixed-signal/custom design flow with open-source tools: the schematic (xschem) is simulated (ngspice), the layout is drawn (klayout, magic) and verified by DRC, extraction, and LVS (netgen); parasitic extraction (magic) feeds a back-annotated re-simulation, and after reliability checks the block is done. Failing checks loop back to the layout or the schematic."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, FancyArrowPatch, FancyBboxPatch


def box(ax, x, y, text, w=3.4, h=1.0, kind='proc'):
    if kind == 'term':
        # shrink by the pad so the padded outer edge matches w x h exactly
        p = 0.08
        ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x - w / 2 + p, y - h / 2 + p),
                                    w - 2 * p, h - 2 * p,
                                    boxstyle=f'round,pad={p}',
                                    fc='#f4e8d8', ec='k', lw=1.0))
    else:
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x - w / 2, y - h / 2), w, h, fc='#e8eef4',
                               ec='k', lw=1.0))
    ax.text(x, y, text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8)


def arr(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x0, y0), (x1, y1), arrowstyle='->',
                                 mutation_scale=11, lw=1.0,
                                 shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0))


fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5, 6.4))

# left column: schematic side
box(ax, 2.5, 10.4, 'Schematic (xschem)\nor netlist', kind='term')
box(ax, 2.5, 8.9, 'Electrical rule check')
box(ax, 2.5, 7.4, 'Circuit simulation\n(ngspice or vacask)')
box(ax, 2.5, 5.9, 'Layout construction\n(klayout or magic)')
box(ax, 2.5, 4.4, 'Design rule check\n(klayout or magic)')
box(ax, 2.5, 2.9, 'Circuit extraction\n(magic or klayout)')
box(ax, 2.5, 1.4, 'Layout vs. schematic\n(klayout or netgen)')
for y0 in [9.9, 8.4, 6.9, 5.4, 3.9, 2.4]:
    arr(ax, 2.5, y0, 2.5, y0 - 0.5)

# right column: post-layout
box(ax, 8.0, 10.4, 'Parasitic extraction\n(magic or klayout-pex)')
box(ax, 8.0, 8.9, 'Schematic back-annotation\n(xschem)', w=4.2)
box(ax, 8.0, 7.4, 'Re-simulation\n(ngspice or vacask)')
box(ax, 8.0, 5.9, 'Reliability check')
box(ax, 8.0, 4.4, 'IC or module OK', kind='term')
for y0 in [9.9, 8.4, 6.9, 5.4]:
    arr(ax, 8.0, y0, 8.0, y0 - 0.5)

# LVS pass -> parasitic extraction
ax.plot([4.2, 5.4, 5.4], [1.4, 1.4, 10.4], 'k-', lw=1.0)
arr(ax, 5.4, 10.4, 6.3, 10.4)
ax.text(4.5, 1.6, 'pass', fontsize=8)

# loop backs
ax.plot([0.8, 0.1, 0.1], [4.4, 4.4, 5.9], 'k-', lw=1.0)
arr(ax, 0.1, 5.9, 0.8, 5.9)
ax.text(0.15, 4.6, 'fail', fontsize=8)
ax.plot([9.7, 11.2, 11.2], [7.4, 7.4, 11.6], 'k-', lw=1.0)
ax.plot([11.2, 2.5], [11.6, 11.6], 'k-', lw=1.0)
arr(ax, 2.5, 11.6, 2.5, 10.9)
ax.text(10.3, 7.6, 'fail', fontsize=8)

ax.set_xlim(-0.4, 12.4)
ax.set_ylim(0.6, 12.2)
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
